_meta.note: ADC + common ARAM champion rune recommendations

Vayne.coaching_note: Stack Tempo early - don't all-in until 4+ stacks. Condemn into walls for W proc.

Jinx.coaching_note: Switch to rockets once Tempo is stacked. Gathering Storm becomes dominant late.

Tristana.coaching_note: Land W, build 4 Explosive Charge stacks under Tempo, auto reset with E.

Caitlyn.coaching_note: Place traps to proc headshots then trigger Comet. Every trap is a free headshot.

Nilah.coaching_note: You take poke walking in - Resolve secondary reduces that tax. Tempo in extended trades.

Miss Fortune.coaching_note: Scatter E into clumped enemies triggers Comet. Stay behind frontline until ult window.

Lux.coaching_note: Root confirms Comet. CDR from Cosmic Insight maximizes E spam uptime.

Xerath.coaching_note: Safe poke lane - Comet on every Q. Never be in auto range.

Brand.coaching_note: Passive explosions proc Comet. W stun is the key combo starter.

Ziggs.coaching_note: Max Q poke. Short Fuse empowered autos proc Comet. Satchel is your escape.

Zyra.coaching_note: Root into Comet is the core trade. Plants tank skillshots - position them as shields.

Heimerdinger.coaching_note: Turrets proc Comet. Place H-28G at max range to hold the lane indefinitely.

Karthus.coaching_note: Stack AP. Your ult is free damage every teamfight. Slow W to confirm Q hits.

Cassiopeia.coaching_note: Poison uptime = DPS. Twin Fang spam with Conqueror stacks shreds any target.

Ahri.coaching_note: E into full combo procs Electrocute. Use R aggressively once you hit level 6.

Syndra.coaching_note: Q poke into E stun combos. Comet confirms on every stun. Collect spheres for R power.

Veigar.coaching_note: Stack AP passive aggressively. Event Horizon cage = free Comet proc + R execute.

Fiddlesticks.coaching_note: Drain isolated targets to stack Dark Harvest. R into clumped enemies is fight-winning.

Amumu.coaching_note: Land Q then R for full lockdown. Glacial slows help peel and follow up.

Malphite.coaching_note: Stack armor against AD teams. R into Comet poke is your gameplan. Never miss ult.

Sona.coaching_note: Q poke with Comet every few seconds. Ult + Comet in grouped fights.

Janna.coaching_note: Tornado into Comet + slow is safe poke. R to disengage and heal grouped allies.

Lulu.coaching_note: W polymorph confirms Comet. Ult your carry entering fights, not when they're already dead.

Swain.coaching_note: Stack Conqueror in drain fights. E root into Q damage is the bread and butter.

Kennen.coaching_note: Arcane Comet procs on Q + R stuns. Stack marks with auto-Q-auto, comet hits the locked target.

Ashe.coaching_note: Permanent slow makes Glacial even stronger. R from distance into fight is game-changing.

Kog'Maw.coaching_note: Bio-Arcane Barrage uptime = W active as much as possible. Stack AP/AS hybrid.

Twitch.coaching_note: Stack passive stacks then R for mass execute. Never engage before full stacks.

Lucian.coaching_note: Q procs Spellblade AND Tempo - Q-auto-auto pattern stacks Tempo instantly.

Varus.coaching_note: W blight stacks proc faster with Tempo AS. Stack 3 blight then E for root.

Sivir.coaching_note: Ricochet bounces stack Tempo fast vs grouped enemies in ARAM corridor.

Draven.coaching_note: Spinning Axe double-catch with Tempo = highest sustained DPS in ARAM.

Ezreal.coaching_note: TF Spellblade + Tempo = Q then autos. Tempo stacks faster with short-range fights.

Jhin.coaching_note: 4th shot crit heals with Fleet - saves life in ARAM fights. No CDR needed.

Xayah.coaching_note: Feather planting is fastest with Tempo AS. More feathers = bigger E root.

Zeri.coaching_note: Q charges and Sparkling Surge proc off Tempo autos. Chain E wall-hops.

Samira.coaching_note: Style rank S unlocks R - Conqueror stacks fastest during combo chains.

Aphelios.coaching_note: Crescendum turret fires with Tempo AS. Infernum + Tempo = AOE sustained DPS.

Kalista.coaching_note: Spear stacking is fastest with Tempo AS. Rend when 4+ spears stacked.

Senna.coaching_note: Long range + Fleet sustain keeps Senna alive poke phase. Deny health packs with Umbral Glaive.

Kindred.coaching_note: Mark collection gives bonus AS. Tempo amplifies mark-target burst window.

Quinn.coaching_note: Blinding Shot extends Tempo window vs ADC. Valor tag proc on Tempo autos.

Smolder.coaching_note: Q spam stacks at 225 charges faster with Tempo AS synergy.

Corki.coaching_note: Fleet sustain in constant ARAM poke. Package (Special Delivery) bomb for burst spike.

Akshan.coaching_note: Revive passive needs survival - Fleet sustain keeps him alive for W revive.

Taliyah.coaching_note: Arcane Comet locks on after Q empowered hit. Seismic Shove (W) repositions to dodge while comet lands.

Vel'Koz.coaching_note: Q split path guarantees Comet on one target. Research stacks + Comet = true damage burst.

Orianna.coaching_note: W at ball location procs Comet. Shockwave R into Comet window = wombo execute.

Viktor.coaching_note: E laser guarantees Comet. Death Ray + Comet on grouped = AOE burst.

Ryze.coaching_note: Overload chain procs Arcane Comet on every Q-W-Q rotation. Reliable poke + burst from any range.

Karma.coaching_note: Mantra-Q AOE slow procs Comet on all enemies hit simultaneously.

Lissandra.coaching_note: Ice chain + Comet. R self-stasis is a free Zhonya - Comet after R return.

Morgana.coaching_note: 3s Q root procs Comet perfectly. W pool + Comet on rooted target = guaranteed damage.

Rumble.coaching_note: E harpoon slow guarantees Comet. Danger Zone flamethrower procs Comet repeatedly.

Malzahar.coaching_note: E Malefic Visions + Comet on channeled targets. Void swarm procs through Comet.

Annie.coaching_note: Stun proc confirms Electrocute. Tibbers + Electrocute on same target = instant burst.

Zoe.coaching_note: Sleep doubles next damage - Comet into sleep = massive burst. Long-range consistent proc.

Vex.coaching_note: Fear passive procs Comet. E-Looming Darkness AOE Comet on grouped enemies.

Neeko.coaching_note: E root confirms Comet. R stun from untargetable = guaranteed Comet burst window.

Hwei.coaching_note: QE bolt guarantees Comet on stationary targets. WE fear chains into Comet.

Aurelion Sol.coaching_note: Q-breath sustained Comet procs. Stardust stacks increase Q size = wider Comet window.

Aurora.coaching_note: Q detonation guarantees Comet. R realm + Comet = enhanced burst on detonation.

Azir.coaching_note: Q soldier advance procs Comet. Soldier attacks chain Comet procs on grouped.

Twisted Fate.coaching_note: Gold Card stun guarantees Comet. Comet proc every 3-4s on Q spam.

LeBlanc.coaching_note: Q-W-E-auto 4-hit Electrocute guaranteed. Proc at combo start = full Electrocute burst.

Kassadin.coaching_note: Q-W-auto Electrocute combo kills any squishy instantly. Late game R spam stacks fast.

Fizz.coaching_note: Q-W-E combo auto-completes Electrocute. R shark procs instantly on landing.

Ekko.coaching_note: W-Q-R burst Electrocute. Passive 3-hit also procs vs melee range.

Katarina.coaching_note: Reset chains stack Conqueror instantly. Sinister Steel spin stacks 5+ fast.

Akali.coaching_note: Q-passive-auto in W shroud procs Electrocute safely. Shroud buy time for CD.

Diana.coaching_note: Q-auto (Moonsilver)-E-R triggers Electrocute before AOE pull.

Sylas.coaching_note: Extended chain fights stack Conqueror fast. W heals amplified by Conqueror stacks.

Elise.coaching_note: E cocoon → spider pounce → Q Electrocute. Rappel dodge to reset proc window.

Evelynn.coaching_note: W-Q-E Electrocute burst. Last Caress R executes after Electrocute detonation.

Nidalee.coaching_note: Long-range Javelin procs hunt; Pounce-Takedown-Q completes Electrocute.

Aatrox.coaching_note: World Ender R heals from Conqueror stacks. Sustained Q-auto Conqueror stacking.

Darius.coaching_note: Hemorrhage 5 stacks + full Conqueror = Noxian Might + execute. W heal procs.

Garen.coaching_note: E spin stacks Conqueror instantly. Perseverance + Conqueror out-sustain most ARAM fights.

Tryndamere.coaching_note: Undying Rage extends Conqueror. Low HP passive amp = max Conqueror + max AS synergy.

Olaf.coaching_note: Berserker Rage (low HP AS) amplifies Conqueror stacking. R CC-immune Conqueror fight.

Jax.coaching_note: E dodge-stun into full Conqueror dump. Relentless Assault stacks Conqueror fast.

Irelia.coaching_note: Ionian Fervor 6-stack = max DPS + full Conqueror. Bladesurge resets extend.

Fiora.coaching_note: Grand Challenge R reveals all Vitals - full Conqueror during R = massive heal + damage.

Riven.coaching_note: Fast combo animation-cancels full Conqueror in 2s. R execute + full Conqueror stacks.

Camille.coaching_note: Q double-hit stacks Conqueror fast. Hextech Ultimatum cage burst window = full stack.

Gwen.coaching_note: W Hallowed Mist safe Conqueror stacking. Q scissors in W = full Conqueror without risk.

Renekton.coaching_note: Empowered W fury stun = instant Conqueror stacks. R AOE aura extends fight duration.

Ambessa.coaching_note: Dash-chain combat stacks Conqueror instantly. W follow-up dash resets after kill.

Briar.coaching_note: No Mercy bleed + Conqueror = massive sustain. R frenzy always stacks fully.

Illaoi.coaching_note: Tentacle slams proc Grasp repeatedly. Grasp sustain + tentacle heal = unkillable in ARAM.

Mordekaiser.coaching_note: Riftmaker heals + Conqueror = infinite sustain in death realm. R isolates for full stacks.

Nasus.coaching_note: Grasp procs on every Q-stacking auto. Siphoning Strike charges from Grasp procs in ARAM.

Cho'Gath.coaching_note: Rupture (Q) knockup procs Grasp. Feast gives HP; more HP = larger Grasp heals.

Dr. Mundo.coaching_note: R heals % max HP - Grasp + R = infinite sustain. More HP = more Grasp healing.

Sion.coaching_note: W detonation triggers Grasp. More HP from passive = larger Grasp heals.

Urgot.coaching_note: Purge (W) rapid autos stack Conqueror instantly. Death machine stacked Conqueror = massive DPS.

Trundle.coaching_note: Subjugate (R) steals enemy stats - full Conqueror during R = insane damage amplification.

Warwick.coaching_note: R suppress = full Conqueror window. Q heal amplified by Conqueror stacks.

Master Yi.coaching_note: Alpha Strike dodge burst then Tempo dump. Highlander reset extends Tempo indefinitely.

Hecarim.coaching_note: Rampage (Q) stacks + Spirit of Dread (W) ally heal = Conqueror amplified by W.

Kled.coaching_note: W passive 4-auto proc stacks Conqueror. Remount mechanic resets Conqueror timer.

Wukong.coaching_note: Cyclone R stacks Conqueror on every rotation. Clone body slam extends fight.

Rengar.coaching_note: Q burst procs instant Conqueror. Battle Roar (W) removes CC then dumps stacks.

Vi.coaching_note: R Cease and Desist guaranteed knockup = Aftershock. Q Vault Breaker also procs.

Xin Zhao.coaching_note: Three Talon Strike (Q) 3-hit = Conqueror fast. Crescent Guard (R) safe burst window.

Zed.coaching_note: W-R-W-E-Q instant Electrocute burst. Duskblade invis post-R extends burst window.

Talon.coaching_note: W-Q-auto instant Electrocute. Wall-hop flank + Electrocute = surprise one-shot.

Kha'Zix.coaching_note: Q-auto-E procs Electrocute vs isolated carry. Isolation bonus + Electrocute = one-shot.

Naafiri.coaching_note: Q-W leap-auto instant Electrocute. Packmates assist in proc completion.

Qiyana.coaching_note: Element Q + R shockwave instant Electrocute. Wall element Q AOE procs on groups.

Nocturne.coaching_note: Duskbringer trail AS + Tempo stacks. W spell shield then auto dump into Tempo peak.

Shaco.coaching_note: Q invis backstab crit + auto + E completes Electrocute instantly. Box chain fear trap.

Pyke.coaching_note: E stun + Q + auto instant Electrocute. R reset chain = free Electrocute per kill.

Kayn.coaching_note: Darkin form (Rhaast) heals from Conqueror stacks. SA form: Electrocute instead.

Leona.coaching_note: E + W + R all proc Aftershock. Eclipse (W) damage reduction + Aftershock = full tank burst.

Nautilus.coaching_note: Q hook + R chain knockup proc Aftershock. Every auto roots (Riptide) sustains proc.

Shen.coaching_note: Shadow Dash (E) taunt guaranteed Aftershock proc. Twilight Assault % HP damage amplified.

Braum.coaching_note: Q freeze + E-anchor procs Aftershock. Unbreakable (E) projectile blocking reduces burst.

Thresh.coaching_note: Q hook + E flay proc Aftershock. Death Sentence landing confirms Aftershock.

Blitzcrank.coaching_note: Q hook + R static proc Aftershock. Power Fist (E) uppercutt extends Aftershock duration.

Alistar.coaching_note: W-Q double knockback/up procs Aftershock both times. R damage reduction + Aftershock.

Rell.coaching_note: E tether stun + R magnetic field proc Aftershock. Magnet Storm continuous CC.

Sejuani.coaching_note: Q + E + R triple CC chain procs Aftershock. Permafrost stun procs after Aftershock.

Galio.coaching_note: W charge taunt guarantees Aftershock. R global arrive + Aftershock on crowd.

Rammus.coaching_note: Q ball knockup + E taunt proc Aftershock. Defensive Ball Curl (W) reflects amplified.

Gragas.coaching_note: E body slam stun procs Aftershock. R keg throw throws tanks into Aftershock procs.

Jarvan IV.coaching_note: E+Q knockup guarantees Aftershock immediately. Cataclysm cage + Aftershock burst.

Poppy.coaching_note: E terrain pin stuns and procs Aftershock. W anti-dash stops all gap-closes during proc.

Ornn.coaching_note: W unstoppable + R Ram knockup proc Aftershock. Forge upgrades + Aftershock durability.

Gnar.coaching_note: Mega Gnar R wall-slam knockup guarantees Aftershock. Build full tank for Mega duration.

Zac.coaching_note: E launch + R bounce 4x proc Aftershock multiple times. Chunk passive = more HP = more sustain.

Maokai.coaching_note: Q knock-back proc Aftershock. Nature's Grasp R root chain confirms it down corridor.

Nunu & Willump.coaching_note: W snowball knockup procs Aftershock. R Absolute Zero channels inside Aftershock window.

Tahm Kench.coaching_note: Tongue Lash (Q) 3-stack proc Grasp. Thick Skin (E) grey health converts more with Grasp.

Skarner.coaching_note: Spines 3-stack stun procs Aftershock. R Impale drags target through Aftershock zone.

Volibear.coaching_note: Thundering Smash (Q) stun guaranteed Aftershock. Stormbringer (R) leap slam procs too.

Soraka.coaching_note: Aery sends on every Q poke and W heal. Starcall (Q) poke procs Aery repeatedly.

Nami.coaching_note: E on ally procs Aery on their autos. High Aery spam with Q bubble + W bounce.

Bard.coaching_note: Q double-stun + Glacial Augment slows = complete corridor lockdown.

Zilean.coaching_note: Q double bomb stun procs Comet. W rewind resets Q immediately for another Comet.

Rakan.coaching_note: W Battle Dance knockup + R charm proc Aftershock. Gleaming Quill (Q) heal support.

Taric.coaching_note: E Dazzle 2-person stun procs Aftershock. R invincibility during Aftershock window.

Seraphine.coaching_note: Every echo ability double-procs Comet. R global charm across ARAM map = free Comet.

Renata Glasc.coaching_note: W Bailout send Aery to rescued ally. Chemtech Putrifier applies grievous via heals.

Yuumi.coaching_note: Every heal and buff procs Aery while attached. Detach briefly to proc Aery on self.

Ivern.coaching_note: E shield on Daisy + allies procs Aery. Q root + Aery proc on hit champion.

Teemo.coaching_note: Q blind guarantees Comet. Mushrooms and poison proc Comet dots on every tick.

Singed.coaching_note: Fling (E) cast procs Arcane Comet. Run through poison + flung target lights up the comet timing.

Gangplank.coaching_note: Q crit auto with Spellblade + Tempo on barrel chains. Powder Keg chains slow enemies in range.

Graves.coaching_note: Buckshot close range Tempo dump. True Grit armor procs let you stand in Tempo range.

Shyvana.coaching_note: Dragon form extended fight = full Conqueror. Nashor's on-hit Conqueror stack synergy.

Udyr.coaching_note: R Wingborne Storm in Conqueror window = sustained AOE. Stance cycling stacks fast.

Yorick.coaching_note: Maiden + ghouls + Conqueror = 3 damage sources simultaneously. Q stacks extend it.

Lillia.coaching_note: Blooming Blows (Q) procs Arcane Comet on each swing. Kite + comet landing while applying Lullaby stacks.

Yone.coaching_note: Every-other auto magic damage + Tempo = insane sustained split DPS output.

Yasuo.coaching_note: Double crit passive means Tempo crits every auto late. R into tornado = instant stack.

Lee Sin.coaching_note: Q-auto-Q-auto rapid Conqueror stacking. Flurry passive every ability = fast stacks.

Rek'Sai.coaching_note: Queen's Wrath (Q) 3-hit AOE stacks Conqueror fast in groups. Burrow-to-above transition.

Jayce.coaching_note: Ranged E-empowered Q + melee Q-W-E combo Tempo stacks both forms.

Kayle.coaching_note: Level 11+ flame swords: Tempo AS = fire swords hit everyone near target simultaneously.

Bel'Veth.coaching_note: Bel'Veth: sustained Conqueror fight in ARAM. Resolve secondary for survivability.

Kai'Sa.coaching_note: Kai'Sa: Tempo stacks on grouped ARAM fights. Domination secondary for burst.

Pantheon.coaching_note: Pantheon: sustained Conqueror fight in ARAM. Resolve secondary for survivability.
